https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 这一反应凸显了尼日利亚宗教和安全局势中一个令人担忧的问题：越来越多人开始为针对宗教信仰不同于批评者的暴力行为寻找借口，甚至予以庆祝。公民社会立法倡议中心（CISLAC）执行主任Auwal Rafsanjani表示，极端主义与恐怖主义之间日益混淆，正在塑造尼日利亚的安全话语。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: For some Nigerian Muslim fundamentalists, the killing of Yahaya Masussuka prompted relief rather than grief. The reaction highlights a troubling problem in Nigeria’s religious and security landscape: the growing tendency to rationalise or celebrate violence against people whose religious beliefs differ from those of their critics. Over the past two decades, many prominent Islamic clerics, including Ja’afar Adam and Auwal Albani, have been assassinated in northern Nigeria. Some of their theological rivals celebrated or justified their deaths, arguing that the clerics had fallen victim to the same brand of extremism they had helped nurture. Auwal Rafsanjani, the executive director of Civil Society Legislative Advocacy Centre (CISLAC), said the growing confusion between extremism and terrorism is shaping Nigeria’s security discourse. “Extremist ideologies that promote hatred, justify violence and encourage recruitment into armed groups can create a pathway to terrorism,” he said, noting not all extremists are terrorists. Mr Masussuka, an Islamic cleric, was shot dead outside his home in Katsina State on the evening of 26 October. His friend, Adamu Abubakar, was also killed in the attack, which the police said was carried out by two assailants on a motorcycle. Given earlier reports of assassination threats against the cleric, some of his supporters initially suspected supporters of rival Sunni or Izala scholars with whom he had engaged in online disputes. However, there is no evidence linking the groups to the killing. Some Izala scholars have also rejected the allegations, saying they have never been involved in killings or advocated violence since the group’s inception in 1978. The narrative shifted when Ansaru, a breakaway faction of Boko Haram, claimed responsibility for the killing . Also known as Jama’atu Ansarul Muslimina Fi Biladis Sudan, the al-Qaeda-linked group, which operates around the Kainji corridors, said it targeted Mr Masussuka because of his rejection of hadiths and advocacy for peaceful coexistence among people of different faiths. Despite Ansaru claiming responsibility, some of Mr Masussuka’s supporters continue to accuse rival religious scholars of complicity, dismissing Ansaru’s statement as a calculated attempt to divert suspicion from the Izala movement. No established evidence has linked the movement to the killing. Amnesty International Nigeria condemned the assassination and called for a thorough investigation. President Bola Tinubu also condemned the killing and directed security agencies to investigate the incident. The terrorists who claimed responsibility for killing Mr Masussuka branded him an “infidel”, a label suggesting he is not a true Muslim. Under the guise of criticising his controversial religious views, some of Mr Masussuka’s critics continue to gloat over his killing. Their reactions illustrate how doctrinal differences and religious intolerance can create an environment in which violence against dissenting voices is rationalised, celebrated or ignored. One critic linked Mr Masussuka to the dreadful Maitatsine movement , a claim contradicted by the timeline, given the fact that the slain cleric was about a year old when the uprising occurred. Another person posted that the threat posed by people like Mr Masussuka was worse than the insecurity ravaging Nigeria. Similar comments, some challenged and others left unanswered, have deepened divisions within the country’s Muslim community. The hostility surrounding Mr Masussuka’s teachings did not emerge in isolation; rather, it is woven into the wider history of religious contestation among Muslims in Nigeria and across the globe. Disagreements over religious interpretation have fuelled tensions and, at times, violent confrontations among Muslim groups in northern Nigeria, including the Tijaniyya, Qadiriyya and Sunni-Salafi or Izala movements. In Sects & Social Disorder: Muslim Identities and Conflict in Northern Nigeria, a collection edited by the late academic, Abdul Mustapha , scholars examine how competing interpretations of Islam have shaped religious identities, sectarian divisions and conflict in the region. In the book’s concluding chapter, Mr Mustapha traces the history of violent disagreements between Islamic groups, including the disputes between Sufi and reformist Muslim movements. He argues that doctrinal differences became particularly dangerous when groups began to treat their claims to religious authenticity as mutually exclusive. The author notes that the language used on both sides of the Izala-Sufi dispute helped incite violence. The disputes extended beyond theological debates, disrupting daily social life. They restricted access to mosques, curbed the right to preach or practice publicly, and strained relationships within families and communities. In extreme cases, opposing members refused to pray together, exchange greetings, or attend each other’s funerals. This friction has extended to higher education in Nigeria, where Muslim student organisations such as the Muslim Students’ Society of Nigeria (MSSN) and Tijanniya Muslim Students’ Association of Nigeria (TIMSAN) share a long history of bitter rivalry. Mr Mustapha also examines takfirism, the practice of declaring another Muslim an unbeliever, infidel or apostate. Although the practice is not exclusive to jihadi groups, violent Sunni jihadists have weaponised it to justify hostility and attacks against people they consider religiously illegitimate. He explains that distinctions between mistakes, sin and unbelief have often been blurred in northern Nigeria, allowing accusations of apostasy to be directed at religious opponents and used to justify violence. This history offers context for the reactions to Mr Masussuka’s killing. It shows how disagreements over religious teachings can escalate from criticism to the denial of another person’s religious legitimacy and, in extreme cases, the justification of violence against them. The takfirism problem must be stopped, Mr Makari said, calling for the protection of every citizen. He added that regulation of religious speeches, which often spur violence, is long overdue. Mr Masussuka was known for his “Quran-only” teachings and advocacy for peaceful coexistence among Muslims and Christians. His “rejection of the hadiths” as an authoritative source of Islamic teachings, however, attracted opposition from other religious scholars and groups. In one of his interviews, Mr Masussuka sought to clarify the many controversies surrounding his persona and teachings, noting that he did not blanketly reject all hadiths. The deceased scholar explained that he only rejected hadiths that tarnish the image of Prophet Muhammad, contradicted Quranic evidence, or promoted and justified terrorism and violence. In November 2025, the Katsina State Government acknowledged receiving complaints from the cleric that some members of the Izala movement had insulted him and threatened to attack him. The government also received complaints about his teachings and referred the matter to the Katsina Emirate Council. There is no established evidence linking those earlier complaints or the people accused of threatening him to his killing. Nor is there established evidence implicating the Izala movement in the attack. Nevertheless, the history of disagreements surrounding his teachings highlights the difficulty of accommodating divergent religious interpretations in an environment where theological differences can become grounds for hostility. While Mr Masussuka’s killing has once again drawn attention to religious intolerance within Muslim communities, the problem is not exclusive to Islam or northern Nigeria. People across the country have faced intimidation, violence and discrimination because of their religious beliefs, including Christians and adherents of traditional African religions. In May 2022, Deborah Samuel, a Christian student at Shehu Shagari College of Education in Sokoto, was beaten and burnt to death by fellow students after being accused of blasphemy against Islam. Another Christian, Rhoda Jatau, was arrested and charged with blasphemy after sharing a WhatsApp message condemning Deborah’s killing. Traditional religious practitioners have also faced hostility. In Kwara State, adherents of traditional religions have reported threats, discrimination and restrictions on their religious activities. In Delta State, a Christian prophet and members of his congregation destroyed a traditional shrine and historical artefacts belonging to an Egbesu-worshipping community in December 2024. A Federal High Court subsequently ruled that the harassment of the traditional worshippers was unconstitutional and ordered the church members to rebuild the shrine and pay damages. Although these incidents differ in their circumstances and severity, they point to a recurring problem which authorities still struggle to curb. Military authorities and security experts have repeatedly said that response to terrorism cannot be limited to military operations, arrests and the disruption of armed groups. While the military’s ‘non-kinetic’ counterterrorism approach is mostly limited to peace deals with terrorists, deliberate efforts must be made to address the narratives that allow extremist organisations to portray people with different beliefs as enemies deserving punishment. “Religious and traditional leaders must play stronger roles in countering extremist narratives, promoting peaceful coexistence and protecting young people against religious manipulation, drug abuse and recruitment into violent organisations,” Mr Rafsanjani said. “He said the government must distinguish between criminal violence and legitimate religious beliefs, peaceful political expression and lawful dissent,” he added
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 马苏斯卡遇害凸显尼日利亚的极端主义与恐怖主义问题
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 对一些尼日利亚穆斯林原教旨主义者来说，Yahaya Masussuka被杀引发的不是悲痛，而是如释重负。这一反应凸显了尼日利亚宗教与安全局势中一个令人不安的问题：越来越多人倾向于合理化针对宗教信仰不同于自身的群体的暴力，甚至为其喝彩。过去20年里，包括Ja’afar Adam和Auwal Albani在内的许多知名伊斯兰教cler人在尼日利亚北部遭暗杀。其中一些人教派对手庆祝他们的死亡或为其辩护，称这些cleric已经成为他们亲手培育的同一极端主义的牺牲品。公民社会立法倡导中心（CISLAC）执行主任Auwal Rafsanjani表示，极端主义与恐怖主义之间日益混淆的现象正在塑造尼日利亚的安全话语。他说：“鼓吹仇恨、为暴力辩护并鼓励人们加入武装组织的极端主义意识形态，可能为恐怖主义铺就道路。”他同时指出，并非所有极端分子都是恐怖分子。Masussuka先生是一名伊斯兰教cler人，10月26日晚在卡塔纳州自家门外遭枪杀。他的朋友Adamu Abubakar也在此次袭击中遇害。警方称，袭击由两名骑摩托车的袭击者实施。鉴于此前曾有针对Masussuka的暗杀威胁报道，他的部分支持者起初怀疑是与其在网上争论的敌对逊尼派或Izala派学者的支持者所为。然而，没有证据将这些团体与这起杀人案联系起来。一些Izala派学者也否认了相关指控，称自该团体1978年成立以来，他们从未参与杀人，也从未鼓吹暴力。当自称对此次谋杀负责的Ansaru出现后，舆论转向。Ansaru是博科哈拉的分裂派别，又称Jama’atu Ansarul Muslimina Fi Biladis Sudan。这个与基地组织有关联、在凯恩吉走廊一带活动的团体称，它针对Masussuka先生，是因为他拒绝圣训并主张不同信仰的人和平共处。尽管Ansaru宣称对此次袭击负责，Masussuka先生的部分支持者仍继续指控敌对宗教学者涉案，并将Ansaru的声明斥为企图把嫌疑从Izala派运动转移出去的算计。尚无确凿证据将该运动与此案联系起来。国际特赦组织尼日利亚分部谴责这起暗杀事件，并呼吁展开全面调查。总统Bola Tinubu也谴责这起杀人事件，并指示安全机构调查此案。宣称杀害Masussuka先生的恐怖分子给他贴上“异教徒”的标签，这一称呼暗示他不是真正的穆斯林。一些Masussuka先生的批评者以批评其有争议的宗教观点为掩护，继续对其遇害幸灾乐祸。他们的反应表明，教义分歧和宗教不宽容如何营造出一种环境，使针对异见者的暴力能够被合理化、庆祝或无视。一名批评者将Masussuka先生与可怕的Maitatsine运动联系起来，但时间线否定了这一说法，因为遇害cleric在起义发生时大约只有1岁。另一人发文称，像Masussuka先生这样的人所构成的威胁，比蹂躏尼日利亚的安全局势更严重。类似言论有的受到质疑，有的无人回应，进一步加深了该国穆斯林社区内部的分裂。围绕Masussuka先生 teachings的敌意并非孤立出现，而是嵌入尼日利亚乃至全球穆斯林之间更广泛的宗教冲突史。围绕宗教解释的争议助长了紧张局势，并有时引发尼日利亚北部不同穆斯林团体之间的暴力冲突，包括Tijaniyya、Qadiriyya以及逊尼—萨拉菲派或Izala派运动。在已故学者Abdul Mustapha编辑的文集《教派与社会失序：尼日利亚北部的穆斯林身份与冲突》中，各学者考察了不同的伊斯兰教解释如何塑造该地区的宗教身份、教派分裂与冲突。在该书最后一章，Mustapha先生追溯了伊斯兰团体之间暴力分歧的历史，包括苏菲派与改革派穆斯林运动之间的争端。他认为，当各团体开始把自己对宗教正统性的主张视为互不相容时，教义分歧便变得格外危险。作者指出，Izala派与苏菲派争端双方所使用的语言有助于煽动暴力。这些争端超出了神学辩论范畴，扰乱日常生活，限制人们进入清真寺的权利，削弱公开讲道或举行宗教活动的权利，并使家庭和社区内部关系紧张。在极端情况下，对立派成员拒绝一起祈祷、互致问候或参加对方的葬礼。这种摩擦还延伸至尼日利亚高等教育领域，尼日利亚穆斯林学生会（MSSN）和尼日利亚Tijanniya穆斯林学生协会（TIMSAN）等穆斯林学生组织之间长期存在激烈竞争。Mustapha先生还考察了takfirism，即把另一名穆斯林称为不信者、异教徒或叛教者的做法。尽管这种做法并非圣战组织所独有，激进的逊尼派圣战者却将其武器化，以此为针对他们认为在宗教上不正当之人的敌意和袭击辩护。他解释道，尼日利亚北部经常混淆错误、罪过与不信，从而让针对宗教对手的叛教指控得以发出，并被用来为暴力辩护。这段历史为外界对Masussuka先生遇害的反应提供了背景。它表明，围绕宗教教义的争执如何从批评升级为否认他人宗教合法性，极端情况下甚至演变为对暴力袭击的正当化。Makari先生说，必须制止takfirism问题，并呼吁保护每一位公民。他还指出，对宗教言论进行监管早已刻不容缓，因为这些言论往往会煽动暴力。Masussuka先生因其“唯《古兰经》”教义以及主张穆斯林与基督徒和平共处而知名。然而，他拒绝将圣训视为伊斯兰教义的权威依据，也因此招致其他宗教学者和团体的反对。在一次采访中，Masussuka先生试图澄清围绕其个人形象和教义的诸多争议，指出自己并非全盘否定所有圣训。已故学者解释道，他只拒绝那些诋毁先知穆罕默德形象、与《古兰经》证据相抵触，或宣扬并正当化恐怖主义和暴力的圣训。2025年11月，卡塔纳州政府承认收到这位cleric的投诉，称Izala派运动的一些成员侮辱他并威胁要袭击他。政府还收到了针对其教义的投诉，并将此事转交卡塔纳埃米尔委员会。尚无确凿证据将这些早期投诉或被指控威胁他的人与此案联系起来，也没有确凿证据 implicating Izala派运动参与此次袭击。尽管如此，围绕其教义的分歧历史凸显出，在神学差异可能成为敌意基础的环境里，容纳不同宗教解释有多么困难。虽然Masussuka先生遇害再次使穆斯林社区内部的宗教不宽容问题受到关注，但这个问题并非伊斯兰教或尼日利亚北部所独有。全国各地的人都曾因宗教信仰而遭受恐吓、暴力和歧视，包括基督徒和非洲传统宗教的信徒。2022年5月，基督徒学生Deborah Samuel在索科托Shehu Shagari教育学院被同学殴打并烧死，原因是她被指控亵渎伊斯兰教。另一名基督徒Rhoda Jatau因分享谴责Deborah被杀一事的WhatsApp消息被捕，并被控亵渎罪。传统宗教从业者同样遭受敌意。在夸拉州，传统宗教信徒报告遭到威胁、歧视以及宗教活动受限。在三角洲州，2024年12月，一名基督徒先知及其会众摧毁了一个崇拜Egbesu的社群所属的传统神龛和历史文物。联邦高等法院随后裁定，骚扰传统崇拜者违反宪法，并命令该教会成员重建神龛并赔偿损失。尽管这些事件在情节和严重程度上各不相同，但它们都指向一个反复出现、而当局仍难以遏止的问题。军方当局和安全专家多次表示，反恐行动不能仅限于军事行动、逮捕和瓦解武装团体。军方采用的“非动能”反恐手段目前主要局限于与恐怖分子达成和平协议，但必须采取有针对性的行动，处理那些让极端主义组织得以将信仰不同者描绘为应受惩罚之敌的叙事。Rafsanjani先生说：“宗教和传统领袖必须在抵制极端主义叙事、促进和平共处以及保护年轻人免受宗教操纵、药物滥用和招募进入暴力组织方面发挥更大的作用。”他还补充说：“他说，政府必须区分犯罪暴力与正当宗教信仰、和平政治表达与合法异议。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Lawmaker's visa issued 1 day before departure The delay of U.S. visa issuance for a ruling party lawmaker has become a topic of debate between rival parties over whether it is a sign of growing friction in the Korea-U.S. alliance. The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) called the incident a clear sign of eroded trust within the alliance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 议员出发前一天才获发签证 美国延迟向执政党议员签发签证，引发朝野两党争论：这是否表明韩美同盟的摩擦正在加剧。主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）称，这一事件清楚显示同盟内部信任遭到侵蚀。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Lawmaker's visa issued 1 day before departure The delay of U.S. visa issuance for a ruling party lawmaker has become a topic of debate between rival parties over whether it is a sign of growing friction in the Korea-U.S. alliance. The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) called the incident a clear sign of eroded trust within the alliance. "It is a symbolic moment that clearly exposes the widening rift in the Korea-U.S. alliance and the total breakdown of trust between the two countries,” Rep. Park Sung-hoon, senior spokesperson for the PPP, said in a statement Saturday. “It is an unprecedented diplomatic embarrassment and a national disgrace that the chairman of Korea's parliamentary defense committee was required to submit an English translation of a past National Security Act conviction and a criminal record check to the U.S., our ally, before finally receiving entry permission,” Park wrote. Park's statement came after Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), the chairman of the Assembly's National Defense Committee, announced that his visa was issued belatedly, a day before the committee's planned departure for the U.S. Pacific Command in Hawaii. Jin said Wednesday that he received a visa refusal notice and expressed regret, saying his trip was not personal but official, aimed at meeting government and military officials in the U.S. The exact reason for the denial was unknown, but some observers assumed that it was in relation to the lawmaker’s 1980s violation of the National Security Law, which is common among former pro-democracy protesters. Jin's was the second such case, as former DPK leader Rep. Jung Chung-rae also had visa delays last month, eventually forcing him to change his parliamentary inspection itinerary to Europe. Jung was involved in anti-U.S. activities in the 1980s. "Jin may board the plane to Hawaii as if nothing happened, but it does not remove the current shaky state of the alliance," Park wrote. The DPK pushed back against the claims, accusing the PPP of politicizing the issue rather than supporting parliamentary duties. "When legitimate parliamentary activities have been hindered, how can the PPP attack their own fellow lawmaker? The PPP has no interest in protecting the national interest," Rep. Lee Ju-hee, floor spokesperson for the DPK, said in a statement Saturday, urging the PPP to apologize for politicizing the matter. DPK spokesperson Shin Hyun-young also said the PPP "should refrain from making remarks that would harm the Korea-U.S. alliance or trying to drive a wedge between Seoul and Washington.” As to the visa issue, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, implied that it was an “individual” case based on past behavior. “I think there was one particular visa individually that there was an issue about regarding behavior, perhaps a couple of decades ago. But we'll work through that at a bilateral basis, not in a press conference,” Rubio told reporters Saturday (local time) during a press conference following a G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. His comments came after he had a meeting with Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, who said last week before his departure to the U.S. that he would discuss the issue with Rubio
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 随着围绕联盟的政治角力浮现，美国签证签发延迟问题成为焦点
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 议员签证在出发前一天才获签 美国延迟向执政党议员签发签证，引发朝野竞争党派之间关于这是否意味着韩美同盟摩擦日益加剧的争论。主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）称，这一事件明确表明同盟内部的信任正在削弱。PPP高级发言人朴成勋议员周六在一份声明中表示：“这是一个象征性时刻，清楚地暴露出韩美同盟之间日益扩大的裂痕，以及两国之间信任的彻底崩塌。”朴写道：“韩国议会国防委员会主席在最终获准入境美国之前，竟不得不向我们的盟友美国提交其过去因违反《国家安全法》而被定罪的英文翻译文件和无犯罪记录证明，这是前所未有的外交尴尬，也是国家的耻辱。”朴的声明发布前，执政的韩国民主党（DPK）议员、国会国防委员会主席金银峻宣布，他的签证直到委员会原定出发前往美国驻夏威夷太平洋司令部前一天才获签。金银峻周三表示，他收到了拒签通知并表达了遗憾，称此次出行并非私人访问，而是公务访问，旨在会见美国政府和军方官员。拒签的确切原因尚不清楚，但一些观察人士认为，这可能与该议员在20世纪80年代违反《国家安全法》的记录有关，这种情况在昔日支持民主的抗议人士中较为常见。金银峻是第二起类似案例，因为前DPK领导人郑清莱议员上月也曾遭遇签证延迟，最终不得不将议会考察行程改为前往欧洲。郑清莱曾参与20世纪80年代的反美活动。朴写道：“金银峻或许会像什么都没发生过一样登上飞往夏威夷的飞机，但这并不能消除当前同盟动荡不稳的状态。”DPK则反驳了有关说法，指责PPP是在将这一问题政治化，而非支持议会履职。DPK党鞭李珠希议员周六在一份声明中说：“当合法的议会活动受到阻碍时，PPP怎么能攻击自己的 fellow lawmaker？PPP无意维护国家利益。”她敦促PPP为将此事政治化而道歉。DPK发言人申铉英也表示，PPP“应避免作出损害韩美同盟的言论，也不要试图在首尔与华盛顿之间挑拨离间。”与此同时，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥就签证问题暗示，这是一起基于过往行为的“个人”案件。鲁比奥周六（当地时间）在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团外长会议后举行的新闻发布会上对记者说：“我认为，当时确实有一个涉及个人行为的签证出了问题，可能是几十年前的事。但我们会在双边层面处理此事，而不是在新闻发布会上讨论。”此前，他曾会见韩国外交部长赵显；赵显上周赴美国前表示，他将与鲁比奥讨论此事

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Contract provides momentum for MASGA initiative Hanwha Group has won its first contract to build a warship for the United States Navy after its acquisition of Philadelphia-based Philly Shipyard in December 2024, marking a tangible step forward in the Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation initiative known as Make American Shipbuilding Great Again (MASGA).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 合同为MASGA倡议注入动力 韩华集团继2024年12月收购总部位于费城的费城船厂后，首次获得为美国海军建造军舰的合同，标志着韩美造船合作倡议“让美国造船再次伟大”（MASGA）取得切实进展。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Contract provides momentum for MASGA initiative Hanwha Group has won its first contract to build a warship for the United States Navy after its acquisition of Philadelphia-based Philly Shipyard in December 2024, marking a tangible step forward in the Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation initiative known as Make American Shipbuilding Great Again (MASGA). Hanwha Group said Sunday that Hanwha Defense USA has signed a $269 million (357.5 billion won) contract with TOTE Services to build a landing ship medium (LSM). TOTE Services is a vessel construction manager entrusted by the U.S. Navy with overseeing shipbuilding contracts and managing vessel construction. The construction of the LSM is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of next year, and the contract also includes options for three additional vessels. The LSM is an expeditionary landing vessel designed to support the U.S. Navy's operations in contested coastal areas, including the Indo-Pacific region. It is tasked with transporting and deploying Marine Corps personnel, equipment and supplies to coastal areas. The U.S. Navy aims to secure 35 LSMs. The vessel measures 100 meters in length and 16 meters in width, with a light displacement of approximately 2,687 tons and a cruising range of about 7,400 kilometers. The U.S. Navy’s LSM program is based on the LST-100 design developed by Dutch shipbuilder Damen. The Navy plans to accelerate the initial deployment of the vessels by using an existing commercial design and building them simultaneously at multiple shipyards. TOTE Services selected the shipbuilders through a competitive bidding process, evaluating their safety records, quality standards and track records for on-time delivery. Hanwha Philly Shipyard has maintained a longstanding partnership with TOTE Services, building and delivering four National Security Multi-Mission Vessels under the vessel construction manager model for the U.S. Maritime Administration. Hanwha Defense USA has also deployed personnel to Philadelphia since early this year to support the shipyard's preparations for U.S. Navy projects. Hanwha Group said the order bears significance as it demonstrates Hanwha Philly Shipyard's capabilities to build not only commercial vessels but also naval ships, laying a strategic foundation for expanding its business with the U.S. Navy. Hanwha Group acquired Philly Shipyard for $100 million in 2024 and announced plans in 2025 to invest $5 billion in upgrading the shipyard's infrastructure. In March, Hanwha Philly Shipyard and Hanwha Defense USA participated in the conceptual design of the U.S. Navy's Next Generation Logistics Ship. In July, the shipyard was also selected to build a Missile Range Instrumentation Vessel for the U.S. Golden Dome missile defense system. In September, Hanwha also established a new subsidiary, Hanwha Defense USA Shipbuilding, to operate Hanwha Philly Shipyard and strengthen the group’s shipbuilding and naval defense businesses in the U.S. With the latest order, Hanwha has expanded its involvement in U.S. Navy projects from ship design to construction. "Since acquiring Philly Shipyard in 2024, Hanwha has made substantial investments in personnel and technology to establish a shipbuilding base capable of serving federal government customers, including the U.S. Navy," Hanwha Defense USA CEO Michael Coulter said. "We will continue working with TOTE Services to ensure the vessel is delivered on schedule and within budget." The contract also carries significance as it marks a tangible achievement in warship construction just 15 months after Seoul proposed the MASGA initiative. Under the initiative, Korea agreed to commit $150 billion to bilateral shipbuilding cooperation to help rebuild the U.S. shipbuilding industry and strengthen its naval shipbuilding capabilities. Last year, the U.S. announced plans to procure 364 new vessels by 2054, comprising 293 combat ships and 71 logistics and support vessels, as it seeks to strengthen its naval capability amid intensifying competition with China. Against this backdrop, industry officials said the latest contract served as a stepping stone to provide further momentum for future projects with Korean shipbuilders. U.S. Senator Dave McCormick highlighted Hanwha's planned $5 billion investment in Philadelphia as an example of how cooperation with close U.S. allies can help rebuild America's shipbuilding capacity and strengthen its defense industrial base. “Pennsylvania is leading the way as we rebuild American shipbuilding, bringing jobs, manufacturing and opportunity back to our state,” McCormick said. “Hanwha’s continued commitment to Philadelphia shows what is possible when we invest in American workers and American industry.”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 合同为MASGA倡议注入动力：韩华集团继2024年12月收购总部位于费城的Philly Shipyard后，首次获得美国海军舰船建造合同，标志着韩美造船合作倡议“让美国造船业再次伟大”（MASGA）取得实质性进展。韩华集团周日表示，旗下韩华防务美国公司与TOTE Services签署了一份价值2.69亿美元（3575亿韩元）的合同，将建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）。TOTE Services是美国海军委托的船舶建造管理公司，负责监督造船合同并管理舰船建造。该登陆舰预计于明年第四季度开工，合同还包含增建3艘舰船的选择权。LSM是一种远征登陆舰，旨在支持美国海军在争议沿海地区，包括印太地区的行动，负责将海军陆战队人员、装备和物资运送并部署至沿海地区。美国海军计划部署35艘LSM。该舰长100米、宽16米，轻载排水量约2687吨，巡航里程约7400公里。美国海军的LSM项目以荷兰造船商Damen开发的LST-100设计为基础。海军计划利用现有商业设计加速舰船的初始部署，并在多家船厂同时建造。TOTE Services通过竞争性招标程序选择造船商，评估其安全记录、质量标准以及按期交付的业绩。韩华Philly Shipyard与TOTE Services保持着长期合作关系，按照船舶建造管理模式，为美国海事管理局建造并交付了4艘国家安全多任务舰。韩华防务美国公司今年早些时候还向费城派驻人员，支持船厂为美国海军项目做准备。韩华集团表示，这份订单具有重要意义，因为它证明韩华Philly Shipyard不仅能够建造商用舰船，也具备建造军用舰船的能力，为扩大与美国海军的业务往来奠定了战略基础。韩华集团于2024年以1亿美元收购Philly Shipyard，并于2025年宣布计划投资50亿美元升级船厂基础设施。今年3月，韩华Philly Shipyard和韩华防务美国公司参与了美国海军“下一代后勤舰”的概念设计。7月，该船厂还入选为美国“金穹”导弹防御系统建造导弹靶场测量舰。9月，韩华还成立了新子公司韩华防务美国造船公司，负责运营韩华Philly Shipyard，并强化该集团在美国的造船和海防业务。随着最新订单的落地，韩华已将对美国海军项目的参与范围从舰船设计扩大至建造。韩华防务美国公司首席执行官Michael Coulter表示：“自2024年收购Philly Shipyard以来，韩华在人员和技术方面投入了大量资源，建立了能够服务包括美国海军在内的联邦政府客户的造船基地。我们将继续与TOTE Services合作，确保舰船按期并在预算范围内交付。”这份合同还具有重要意义，因为就在首尔提出MASGA倡议仅15个月后，舰船建造便取得了实质性成果。根据该倡议，韩国同意承诺投入1500亿美元开展双边造船合作，以帮助重建美国造船业并增强其军用舰船建造能力。去年，美国宣布计划到2054年前采购364艘新舰船，其中包括293艘作战舰和71艘后勤及支援舰，以应对与中国日益加剧的竞争并增强海军能力。在这一背景下，业内人士表示，最新合同为韩国造船商承接未来项目进一步注入动力提供了垫脚石。美国参议员Dave McCormick强调，韩华计划在费城投资50亿美元，证明了与美国这一密切盟友合作有助于重建美国造船能力、强化国防工业基础。McCormick说：“在我们重建美国造船业的过程中，宾夕法尼亚州正发挥带头作用，把就业、制造业和机遇带回本州。韩华对费城的持续投入表明，对美国工人和美国工业进行投资能够带来何种可能。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: President Lee Jae Myung’s anti-diversity rhetoric is doing more harm than good. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 总统李在明的反多样性言论弊大于利。他周二内阁会议上关于移民劳工在韩国经济中所发挥作用的讲话引发争议。从周三开始，他连续发布社交媒体帖子，呼吁重新评估针对多元文化家庭的政策。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: President Lee Jae Myung’s anti-diversity rhetoric is doing more harm than good. His remarks about the role of migrant workers in the Korean economy at Tuesday’s Cabinet meeting sparked controversy. But he did not stop there. Instead, he poured fuel on the fire. In a series of social media posts beginning Wednesday, he called for a reassessment of policies for multicultural families. His remarks have backfired. The president has become a source of concern among members of his own ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK). Few have voiced their concerns publicly, but many DPK lawmakers reportedly believe Lee has gone too far and that someone needs to sound the alarm. Politicians are supposed to bring people together, not divide them. Lee, however, has done the opposite. His anti-diversity rhetoric has undermined his own political standing. Even some of his traditional support groups — particularly progressives — have begun criticizing him. Labor unions have characterized Lee’s remarks as hate speech. The Korean Federation of Trade Unions accused him of treating migrant workers like an ATM, arguing that his comments fuel hostility toward them. The criticism followed media reports about Lee’s remarks at Tuesday’s Cabinet meeting. During the livestreamed meeting, Lee questioned the economic contributions of foreign workers, arguing that they send their earnings back to their home countries. Lee subsequently expressed dissatisfaction with media coverage of his comments. Sharing an article from a left-leaning newspaper on social media, he complained that his remarks had been taken out of context. He openly demanded that the newspaper revise its headline to better reflect his intentions and apologize to him. The outlet changed the headline as he requested, but that apparently was not enough. Lee continued to demand a public apology on social media. The president's response was excessive. The newspaper's correction was an acknowledgment that its original headline had been problematic. Most politicians would have accepted such a correction and moved on. Lee's continued demand for a public apology gives the impression that he was seeking to pressure and publicly embarrass the newspaper rather than settle the dispute. On Wednesday, Lee wrote that preferential policies based on ethnicity should be reviewed. "While it is true that support for multicultural families is necessary, that cannot justify specific policies that are unreasonable or may result in reverse discrimination," he said. On Friday, he called for a level playing field, arguing that some multicultural support measures were unfair. He challenged the assumption that all multicultural families belong to the working class, pointing out that some include children of highly skilled, white-collar foreign workers and their Korean spouses. Such families, he argued, should not automatically be classified as marginalized households. He also called for equal treatment of disadvantaged multicultural families and low-income Korean households. "If there are poor multicultural families, they should be entitled to policy support available to poor Korean households," he wrote, suggesting that government assistance should not be determined by ethnicity but by economic circumstances. Diversity-related spending should not be confused with preferential treatment or a double standard. Tailored policies for multicultural families are necessary to help them integrate into Korean society. Depending on their circumstances, additional public spending on ethnically diverse families is inevitable. According to the Ministry of Data and Statistics, Korea had 451,492 multicultural households in 2025. Their number has continued to increase year after year. More than 70 percent consist of Korean husbands and foreign wives. Vietnam accounts for the largest share of foreign spouses at 30 percent, followed by China at 12.2 percent and Thailand at 5.4 percent. These demographic characteristics underscore the need for targeted policy support. Foreign spouses and their children often need assistance overcoming language barriers and adapting to Korean society. Other social and cultural services are also necessary to help migrant spouses and their children settle into their communities. Such support is not a waste of taxpayer money. It is an investment in the nation's future. Diversity has become an irreversible trend. In 2025, foreign-born residents accounted for 5.24 percent of Korea's population. Their numbers have risen steadily over the past several decades, outpacing earlier projections. As the foreign-born population grows, greater public spending on social integration, education and cultural services will inevitably be required. This should not be viewed as an unfair privilege granted to certain groups. Rather, it is a necessary response to the country's changing demographics. Lee should be promoting social cohesion, not fueling resentment toward minorities. His rhetoric risks undermining the very values of inclusion and solidarity that progressives have traditionally championed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: Ed对平权行动持疑点的看法遭批驳
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 李在明总统的反多样性言论弊大于利。他周二在内阁会议上就外籍劳工作在韩国经济中的作用发表的言论引发争议，但他并未就此收手，反而火上浇油。周三起，他通过一系列社交媒体帖子，呼吁重新审视针对多元文化家庭的政策。他的言论适得其反。总统本人已成为执政的朝鲜民主主义党（DPK）党员忧虑的对象。公开表达担忧者寥寥，但据报道，许多DPK议员认为李在明做得过头，必须有人发出警报。政治人物本应凝聚民众，而非分化民众，李在明却适得其反。他的反多样性言论削弱了自己的政治根基，就连他的一些传统支持群体，尤其是进步派，也开始批评他。工会将李在明的言论定性为仇恨言论。韩国工会联合会指责他把外籍劳工当成取款机，认为其言论煽动针对外籍劳工的敌意。此前，媒体报道了李在明周二内阁会议上的言论。在网络直播的会议上，李在明质疑外籍劳工对经济的贡献，称他们会把自己的收入汇回祖国。此后，李在明对媒体如何报道其言论表示不满。他在社交媒体上分享了一篇左翼报纸的文章，抱怨媒体断章取义，并公开要求该报修改标题，以更好地体现他的本意，同时向他道歉。该媒体按照他的要求修改了标题，但这显然仍不够。李在明继续在社交媒体上要求对方公开道歉。总统的回应过度了。报纸更正标题，等于承认原标题存在问题，多数政治人物都会接受这种更正并继续处理。李在明仍不断要求公开道歉，给人留下的印象是，他是在施压并公开羞辱该报，而不是理性解决分歧。周三，李在明写道，基于族裔的优惠政策应当重新审查。他说：“支持多元文化家庭固然必要，但这不能成为推行不合理政策或可能造成反向歧视的特定政策的理由。”周五，他呼吁实现公平竞争，认为一些针对多元文化群体的扶持措施不公平。他质疑所有多元文化家庭都属于工人阶级的预设，指出其中一些家庭包括高技能外籍劳工及其韩国配偶的孩子。他认为，此类家庭不应被自动归类为边缘化家庭。他还呼吁，对处于不利地位的多元文化家庭和低收入韩国家庭实行平等待遇。他写道：“如果存在贫困的多元文化家庭，他们应当享有面向贫困韩国家庭提供的政策支持。”这表明，政府援助不应依据族裔，而应依据经济状况。与多样性有关的支出不应与优待或双重标准混为一谈。针对多元文化家庭量身定制的政策十分必要，可以帮助他们融入韩国社会。根据各自处境，额外增加对不同族裔家庭的公共支出不可避免。据数据与统计部称，2025年韩国有451,492个多元文化家庭，数量仍在逐年增加，其中超过70%由韩国丈夫和外国妻子组成。外国配偶中，越南占比最高，为30%，其次是中国，为12.2%，泰国为5.4%。这些人口结构特征凸显了实施针对性政策支持的必要性。外国配偶及其子女往往需要帮助克服语言障碍、适应韩国社会。为帮助外籍配偶及其子女融入所在社区，也需要提供其他社会和文化服务。这类支持并非浪费纳税人资金，而是对国家未来的投资。多样性已成为不可逆转的趋势。2025年，外国出生居民占韩国人口的5.24%。过去几十年来，这一群体规模持续增长，并超出此前的预测。随着外国出生人口增加，社会融合、教育和文化服务方面必然需要投入更多公共资金。这不应被视为给予某些群体的不公平特权，而应被视为应对国家人口结构变化的必要举措。李在明应当促进社会凝聚力，而不是煽动针对少数群体的怨恨。他的言论可能损害进步派历来倡导的包容与团结价值观。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 数据显示，韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创1153亿美元的历史纪录，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。韩国贸易、工业和资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的强劲需求，以及主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's exports jumped 93.7 percent to a record $115.3 billion in October from a year earlier, driven largely by a sharp increase in semiconductor shipments, data showed Sunday. Strong global demand for semiconductors, coupled with continued investments by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, boosted overall exports, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release. Imports rose 36 percent from a year earlier to $72.78 billion, resulting in a trade surplus of $42.5 billion. Cumulative exports for the January-October period exceeded $900 billion for the first time, with the ministry projecting that the country's annual exports could reach $1 trillion as early as November if the current trend continues. By sector, semiconductor exports, a key pillar of Asia's fourth-largest economy, skyrocketed 259 percent from a year earlier to $56.4 billion in October, the release said. Exports of petroleum products jumped 80 percent to $6.92 billion, while those of petrochemical products rose 27.5 percent to $4 billion. Cosmetics exports shot up 57.5 percent to $1.44 billion on rising demand in China, the United States and the European Union. Automobile exports gained 18.1 percent to $6.55 billion, driven by increased overseas demand for gasoline hybrid models. By destination, exports to China soared 133.6 percent to $26.98 billion, driven by strong shipments of semiconductors and wireless communications equipment. Exports to China topped $20 billion for the fifth consecutive month. Shipments to the United States surged 185.8 percent to $24.9 billion, supported by robust demand for semiconductors, computers and electrical equipment used in AI infrastructure. The monthly report also showed exports to Southeast Asian countries rose 128 percent to $21.33 billion, while those to the European Union increased 56.4 percent to $8.1 billion, with both gains driven by strong shipments of chips and automobiles. "The global trade environment remains uncertain, with many small and medium-sized enterprises facing difficulties amid rising protectionism in major economies, shifts in global supply chains and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East," Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan said. To address these challenges, the government will step up trade cooperation with major export partners and work to remove barriers to exports to ease the burden on businesses, he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 芯片销售强劲，韩国10月出口额达到1153亿美元
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创纪录的1153亿美元，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。数据显示，韩国工业贸易资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的旺盛需求，加上主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。进口额同比增长36%，达到727.8亿美元，实现贸易顺差425亿美元。1月至10月累计出口额首次突破900亿美元；该部预计，如果当前趋势持续，韩国全年出口额最早可于11月达到1万亿美元。新闻稿称，作为亚洲第四大经济体的支柱行业，半导体出口额10月同比飙升259%，达到564亿美元。石油产品出口额增长80%，达到69.2亿美元；石化产品出口额增长27.5%，达到40亿美元。受中国、美国和欧盟需求上升推动，化妆品出口额猛增57.5%，达到14.4亿美元。混合动力汽车海外需求增加，推动汽车出口额增长18.1%，达到65.5亿美元。按目的地划分，受半导体和无线通信设备出货量强劲推动，对华出口额飙升133.6%，达到269.8亿美元，对华出口额连续第5个月超过200亿美元。得益于半导体、计算机以及人工智能基础设施所用电气设备的旺盛需求，对美出货额激增185.8%，达到249亿美元。月报还显示，对东南亚国家出口额增长128%，达到213.3亿美元；对欧盟出口额增长56.4%，达到81亿美元，两项增长均得益于芯片和汽车出货量强劲。产业部长金正官表示：“全球贸易环境仍不确定，主要经济体保护主义抬头、全球供应链调整以及中东地缘政治紧张，使许多中小企业面临困难。”他说，为应对这些挑战，政府将加强与主要出口伙伴的贸易合作，并努力消除出口壁垒，以减轻企业负担。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title: Nigeria woos Russian investors, seeks local currency trade settlement at Moscow summit
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.summary: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, made the call while delivering Nigeria’s statement at the Third Russia-Africa Summit at the Grand Kremlin Palace, where he also advocated stronger trade and financial arrangements, including independent local currency settlement mechanisms between both countries.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.summary_zh: 外交部国务部长、大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 在克里姆林宫举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会期间发表尼日利亚声明时进行了这次通话。他还在会上主张加强两国之间的贸易和金融安排，包括建立独立的地方货币结算机制。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: Layer 1 The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye Nigeria has called for a shift in its relations with Russia from political commitments to practical economic cooperation, urging Russian investors to explore opportunities in the country’s energy, solid minerals, agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals and digital sectors. The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, made the call while delivering Nigeria’s statement at the Third Russia-Africa Summit at the Grand Kremlin Palace, where he also advocated stronger trade and financial arrangements, including independent local currency settlement mechanisms between both countries. Enikanolaiye, who led Nigeria’s delegation to the summit, said the future of Africa- Russia relations must be measured by tangible economic outcomes, stressing the need to translate longstanding diplomatic ties into investments, technology transfer and development partnerships. He said Nigeria was particularly interested in strengthening cross-border payment arrangements with Russia through mutually agreed systems, alongside improved banking channels and financial infrastructure to facilitate trade and investment. The minister, who conveyed President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s greetings to Russian President Vladimir Putin and the African Union Chairman, President Evariste Ndayishimiye of Burundi, said the private sector must play a greater role in driving the partnership. He urged Russia to collaborate with African countries on commercially viable infrastructure projects covering railways, ports, energy, telecommunications, transport and logistics, noting that such investments would strengthen regional connectivity and support the objectives of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). On the digital economy, Enikanolaiye warned against Africa becoming merely a consumer of imported technology, calling for expanded cooperation in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, software development, digital infrastructure and joint research. He said such partnerships should prioritise technology transfer, capacity building and the development of indigenous technological capabilities across the continent. The minister also identified agriculture and food security as critical areas for cooperation, urging Russia to support African countries in expanding domestic food production, fertiliser availability, irrigation, mechanisation, agricultural research, storage and agro-processing. According to him, recent disruptions to global supply chains have exposed the vulnerability of food systems, making it imperative for African countries to strengthen domestic production and retain more value from their agricultural resources. On security, Enikanolaiye reaffirmed Nigeria’s commitment to peace and stability in Africa, identifying terrorism, violent extremism, transnational organised crime, arms trafficking, piracy and cybercrime as threats requiring coordinated regional and international responses. He, however, stressed that such partnerships must be anchored on African ownership and African-led solutions, with external cooperation strengthening existing regional mechanisms, including the African Union and ECOWAS. The minister further reiterated Nigeria’s commitment to sovereign equality, territorial integrity, non-interference and the peaceful settlement of disputes, while calling for reforms of the United Nations Security Council and international financial architecture to guarantee Africa’s rightful representation. On the outcome of the summit, Enikanolaiye said Nigeria supported the adoption of a focused Africa-Russia Action Plan for 2027–2029, with clear priorities, financing arrangements and monitoring mechanisms to ensure that agreements translated into measurable results. He specifically invited Russian businesses to take advantage of Nigeria’s position as Africa’s largest market and a strategic gateway to West Africa and the AfCFTA, highlighting opportunities in energy, including renewable and nuclear technology, solid minerals, agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, defence and digital services. The minister also said the summit had reinforced the longstanding friendly relations between Nigeria and Russia, recalling Moscow’s historic support for Nigeria’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity dating back to the Soviet era. Speaking at the plenary session, Putin described Russia and Africa as natural allies in building a just multipolar world order, reaffirming his country’s commitment to sovereign equality, expanded diplomatic engagement, security cooperation and greater African representation in global institutions. Similarly, Ndayishimiye stressed that Africa would not exchange one form of subordination for another, insisting that the continent’s international partnerships must respect its independence and development priorities. He said the 2027–2029 Action Plan would provide an opportunity to address infrastructure deficits through technology transfer and skills development, while moving Africa from dependence on external assistance towards greater economic independence. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚在莫斯科峰会吸引俄罗斯投资者，并寻求以当地货币结算贸易
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh:
第一层：尼日利亚外交国务部长兼大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 呼吁尼日利亚与俄罗斯的关系从政治承诺转向务实经济合作，并敦促俄罗斯投资者探索该国能源、固体矿产、农业、制造业、制药和数字经济领域的机会。

尼日利亚外交国务部长兼大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 在克里姆林宫举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会上宣读尼日利亚声明时提出这一主张。他还主张加强贸易和金融安排，包括在两国之间建立独立使用本币的结算机制。

率领尼日利亚代表团出席会议的 Enikanolaiye 表示，非洲与俄罗斯关系的未来必须以切实的经济成果为衡量标准，并强调需要把长期的外交关系转化为投资、技术转让和发展伙伴关系。

他说，尼日利亚尤其希望通过双方商定的机制，加强与俄罗斯之间的跨境支付安排，同时改善银行渠道和金融基础设施，以促进贸易和投资。

这位部长转达了总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu 对俄罗斯总统 Vladimir普京和非洲联盟主席、burundi总统 Evariste Ndayishimiye 的问候，并表示私营部门必须在推动伙伴关系方面发挥更大作用。

他敦促俄罗斯与非洲国家合作开展具有商业可行性的基础设施项目，涵盖铁路、港口、能源、电信、运输和物流，并指出，此类投资将加强区域互联互通，支持非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的目标。

在数字经济方面，Enikanolaiye 警告称，非洲不能仅仅成为进口技术的消费方，并呼吁扩大人工智能、网络安全、软件开发、数字基础设施和联合研究等领域的合作。

他说，此类伙伴关系应优先推动技术转让、能力建设以及非洲大陆本土技术能力的发展。

这位部长还将农业和粮食安全列为合作的关键领域，敦促俄罗斯支持非洲国家扩大国内粮食生产、提高化肥供应能力、发展灌溉、推进农业机械化，并加强农业研究、储存和农产品加工。

据他介绍，近期全球供应链中断暴露了粮食系统的脆弱性，因此非洲国家必须加强国内生产，并从农业资源中保留更多价值。

在安全问题上，Enikanolaiye 重申尼日利亚致力于维护非洲的和平与稳定，并指出恐怖主义、暴力极端主义、跨国有组织犯罪、军火贩运、海盗行为和网络犯罪都是威胁，需要区域和国际社会采取协调应对措施。

不过，他强调，此类伙伴关系必须以非洲自主权和非洲主导的解决方案为基础，外部合作应当加强包括非洲联盟和西非国家经济共同体在内的现有区域机制。

这位部长还重申尼日利亚致力于实现主权平等、维护领土完整、奉行不干涉原则以及和平解决争端，同时呼吁改革联合国安全委员会和国际金融架构，确保非洲获得应有的代表权。

谈及峰会成果，Enikanolaiye 表示，尼日利亚支持通过一项重点明确的《非洲—俄罗斯2027—2029年行动计划》，并明确优先事项、融资安排和监测机制，以确保各项协议转化为可衡量的成果。

他特别邀请俄罗斯企业利用尼日利亚作为非洲最大市场以及通往西非和非洲大陆自由贸易区战略门户的区位优势，并强调能源（包括可再生能源和核技术）、固体矿产、农业、制造业、制药、国防和数字服务等领域蕴含的机会。

这位部长还表示，本次峰会加强了尼日利亚与俄罗斯之间长期存在的友好关系，并回顾了莫斯科自苏联时期以来对尼日利亚统一、主权和领土完整的历史支持。

普京在全会上发言，将俄罗斯和非洲描述为建设公正多极世界秩序的天然盟友，重申俄罗斯致力于实现主权平等、扩大外交接触、加强安全合作以及推动非洲在全球机构中获得更多代表权。

同样，Ndayishimiye 强调，非洲不会以另一种从属形式取代现有的从属关系，并坚持非洲大陆的国际伙伴关系必须尊重其独立性和发展优先事项。

他说，《2027—2029年行动计划》将提供通过技术转让和技能开发来弥补基础设施缺口的机会，同时推动非洲从依赖外部援助转向实现更大程度的经济独立。

这位非盟主席还将水安全列为该大陆机构2026年议程的一项主要优先事项。

上述内容载于这位部长的媒体与公共传播特助 Richard Elesho 周日发布的一份声明。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 卡塔萨州政府将扬卡拉地区法斯卡里地方政府辖区发生的暴力事件归因于对一场穆卢德游行活动的争议，并否认有报道将该事件与州长迪科·拉达的竞选集会联系起来。他说，这起事件与法斯卡里举行的蒂努布—迪科竞选集会毫无关系。州长参观了该地区领主的宫殿，并视察了地方政府秘书处和议事厅的翻修工程，随后出席了竞选集会。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: The Katsina State Government has attributed violence in Yankara, Faskari Local Government Area, to a disagreement over a Maulud procession, denying reports linking the incident to Governor Dikko Radda’s campaign rally. Two vehicles were reportedly burnt and several people injured during the disturbance. In a statement on Saturday, the governor’s Chief Press Secretary, Ibrahim Kaula Mohammed, said participants in the religious procession disagreed with security personnel over designated routes, causing confusion along a public street. He said the incident had no connection with the Tinubu-Dikko campaign rally in Faskari. LEADERSHIP newspaper reported that suspected hoodlums burnt two vehicles, including one belonging to the Musa Adamu Network (MAN), a political association. Several people were reportedly injured, while shops were damaged. Nura Yandaki, chairman of the association’s caucus, told the newspaper that he was travelling with 11 other members to the governor’s rally when the disturbance occurred. He said trouble began around a Maulud procession before suspected hoodlums attacked passing vehicles. Mr Yandaki said members of his delegation escaped unharmed, but their vehicle was destroyed. An unnamed local government official also told LEADERSHIP that two vehicles were burnt and several people injured while residents and political supporters awaited the governor’s arrival. The government’s statement did not address the reported attacks on vehicles carrying people travelling to the rally. Mr Mohammed said Governor Radda passed safely through Yankara on his way to Faskari. The governor visited the district head’s palace and inspected renovation works at the local government secretariat and council chambers before attending the campaign rally. The government called on security agencies to investigate the violence and establish what happened. It also urged media organisations and social media users to verify information before publication and appealed to residents to remain calm and avoid spreading unverified reports
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: 卡蒂纳州政府否认暴力事件与拉达斯竞选集会有关
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 卡塔萨州政府将扬卡拉地区法斯卡里地方政府辖区发生的暴力事件归因于双方对庆祝先知穆罕默德诞辰活动游行路线存在分歧，并否认有报道将该事件与州长迪科·拉达的竞选集会联系起来。据报道，骚乱期间有2辆汽车被烧毁，另有数人受伤。州长首席新闻秘书易卜拉欣·考拉·穆罕默德星期六发表声明称，宗教游行参与者与安全人员就指定路线发生争执，导致一条公共街道陷入混乱。他说，这起事件与提努布和迪科在法斯卡里举行的竞选集会毫无关系。《LEADERSHIP》报报道称，疑似流氓烧毁2辆汽车，其中包括政治组织穆萨·阿达穆网络（MUSА ADAMU NETWORK，简称MAN）的一辆车。据报道，数人受伤，多家商店遭到破坏。该组织议员团主席努拉·扬达基告诉该报，骚乱发生时，他正与另外11名成员前往州长的集会。他说，麻烦始于庆祝先知穆罕默德诞辰活动的游行，随后疑似流氓袭击了途经车辆。扬达基先生说，他所在代表团的成员均安然无恙，但其车辆被毁。一名未具名的地方政府官员也告诉《LEADERSHIP》，2辆汽车被烧毁，数人受伤，当时居民和政治支持者正在等待州长抵达。州政府的声明没有回应有关乘坐车辆前往集会的人群遭袭的报道。穆罕默德先生说，拉达州长前往法斯卡里的途中安全经过扬卡拉。州长视察了该地区酋长的宫殿，并查看了地方政府秘书处和议事厅的翻修工程，随后出席竞选集会。州政府呼吁安全机构调查暴力事件并查明真相，还敦促媒体机构和社交媒体用户在发布信息前加以核实，并呼吁居民保持冷静，避免传播未经证实的消息。

https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.summary: The party alleged a sustained pattern of attacks on its members, including gunshots at the airport, assault on women supporters and vandalisation of its campaign office. Goronyo said the ADC had formally notified the state government of its decision to flag off its presidential campaign in Sokoto, initially slated for October 31, but the government replied expressing disagreement.
https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.summary_zh: 该党指控其成员持续遭到袭击，包括机场枪击、针对女性支持者的殴打以及竞选办公室遭破坏。戈罗尼奥表示，ADC已正式通知索科托州政府，决定为在索科托启动总统竞选举行旗式启动仪式，原定于10月31日举行，但政府回复表示不同意。
https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.body: The party alleged a sustained pattern of attacks on its members, including gunshots at the airport, assault on women supporters and vandalisation of its campaign office. Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, the state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, said the party would remain peaceful and law-abiding but would not surrender its constitutional right to organise political activities. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the state government to investigate the attacks, including the assault on its governorship candidate on October 30. “We demand protection for our candidate and supporters, accountability for those responsible, and an end to any use of state-backed security outfits to restrict lawful political activity,” he said. Goronyo said the ADC had formally notified the state government of its decision to flag off its presidential campaign in Sokoto, initially slated for October 31, but the government replied expressing disagreement. “The government replied by stating its disagreement with the flag-off. That reply raises serious concern about the government’s commitment to political pluralism, freedom of association and the right of opposition parties to hold lawful political activities,” he said. He alleged that the attacks were not isolated but a sustained pattern, which he linked to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. The party identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected to the attacks. “On Wednesday, October 28, 2026, our women were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march. Participants were injured, their mobile phones were snatched, their clothing was torn, and their vehicles and other property were vandalised,” he said. He said on the same day, the ADC state campaign office was attacked, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed, while billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. Goronyo further alleged that hotels booked for the flag-off cancelled reservations under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. “Government-owned hotels reportedly stopped accepting guests on the claim that their rooms were fully booked. We have received reports that hotel operators were threatened with consequences, including the demolition of their properties, if they refused to comply. “We are seeking written confirmation of these reports. If established, they would represent a serious abuse of public authority,” he said. “Who authorised their release, under what legal process, and what safeguards were put in place? Release from prison must never be treated as a licence to intimidate citizens, and political connections must not place anyone beyond accountability,” he asked. Goronyo said the party’s governorship candidate, Manir Muhammad Dan’iya (Walin Sokoto), was attacked at the Sultan Abubakar III International Airport, Sokoto, on Friday, by personnel of the Sokoto Marshals and Sokoto Community Guards. He said his vehicles were smashed and gunshots were fired, while two DSS personnel attached to the candidate were reportedly detained. “The authorities must establish who authorised the operation, what instructions were issued, who discharged firearms and under what authority, and why DSS officers assigned to a political candidate were detained by state security personnel. “Responsibility must not stop at the personnel at the scene: anyone who authorised, directed, sponsored or facilitated unlawful conduct must also be investigated,” he said. He said the party had also received reports that personnel of the two state-owned security outfits had been instructed to prevent ADC supporters from entering Sokoto ahead of the flag-off. “We consider this allegation extremely serious. If confirmed, the instruction would violate the constitutional rights of citizens to freedom of movement, peaceful assembly and political association. “No governor, political party or security commander has the authority to restrict citizens from entering a state because of their political affiliation,” he said. He said residents were entitled to question the state’s security priorities when communities still face banditry and kidnapping. “The ADC is a peaceful political party committed to democratic principles, political tolerance, constitutional freedoms and the rule of law. Our commitment to peace must never be mistaken for weakness or surrender of our constitutional rights. “We will not be intimidated, silenced or forced out of the democratic space through violence, threats or politically motivated harassment,” he declared. He called for a thorough investigation into the gunshots, destruction of vehicles, detention of DSS personnel, alleged involvement of Aliyu K.C. and his associates, threat to hotel operators and denial of venue, as well as protection for ADC candidates, leaders and supporters. https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.title_zh: 索科托2027：人民民主大会党就竞选活动升旗挑战政府
https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.body_zh: 该党指控其成员持续遭到袭击，包括有人在机场开枪、殴打女性支持者以及破坏其竞选办公室。该党州主席兼Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo周日在索科托党总部举行的新闻发布会上表示，该党将继续保持和平并遵守法律，但不会放弃组织政治活动的宪法权利。他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和州政府调查这些袭击，包括10月30日对其州长候选人的殴打。他说：“我们要求保护我们的候选人和支持者，追究肇事者的责任，并制止任何利用国家支持的安全机构限制合法政治活动的行为。”Goronyo表示，ADC已正式通知州政府，决定在索科托启动其总统竞选活动，原定于10月31日举行，但政府回复称不同意举行该活动。他说：“政府回复表示不同意启动竞选活动。这一回复引发了对政府是否致力于政治多元、结社自由以及反对党举行合法政治活动权利的严重关切。”他称，这些袭击并非孤立事件，而是一种持续模式，并将矛头指向据称由州政府从监狱释放的两名与政治暴力有关的人员。该党确认Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些袭击有关。Goronyo说：“2026年10月28日星期三，我们的女性支持者在一次和平声援游行中遭到袭击。参加者受伤，手机被抢，衣服被撕破，车辆及其他财产遭到破坏。”他说，同一天，ADC州竞选办公室也遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被洗劫，3辆摩托车被毁，同时全州范围内的广告牌、海报及其他竞选材料也遭到破坏。Goronyo进一步指控，为竞选启动活动预订的酒店在州政府施压下取消预订，而政府所属酒店则声称房间已被订满。他说：“据报道，政府所属酒店以房间已满为由停止接待客人。我们收到报告称，如果酒店经营者拒绝配合，就可能遭到包括拆除其在内的各种后果。我们正在寻求这些报告的书面确认。如果情况属实，将构成对公共权力的严重滥用。”他质问道：“是谁授权释放他们，采用了什么法律程序，又采取了哪些保障措施？服刑人员获释绝不能被视为恐吓公民的许可证，政治关系也绝不能让任何人免于问责。”Goronyo表示，该党州长候选人Manir Muhammad Dan’iya（Walin Sokoto）周五在索科托Sultan Abubakar III国际机场遭到Sokoto Marshals和Sokoto Community Guards人员袭击。他说，候选人的车辆被砸，枪声响起，而据报道，随行候选人的2名DSS人员被拘留。他说：“当局必须查明是谁授权此次行动，下达了哪些指示，谁在何种权限下开枪，以及为何负责政治候选人的DSS人员会被州安全人员拘留。责任调查不能止于现场人员：任何授权、指示、资助或协助违法行为的个人也必须接受调查。”他还说，该党收到报告称，两支州属安全机构的人员已接到指示，要阻止ADC支持者在竞选启动活动前进入索科托。他说：“我们认为这一指控极其严重。如果得到证实，该指示将侵犯公民自由迁徙、和平集会和政治结社的宪法权利。没有任何州长、政党或安全指挥官有权仅因公民的政治立场而限制他们进入一个州。”他表示，在各社区仍面临武装劫匪和绑架活动的情况下，州居民有权质疑州政府的安全优先事项。他说：“ADC是一个坚持民主原则、政治包容、宪法自由和法治的和平政党。我们对和平的承诺绝不能被误认为软弱，也不能被视为放弃宪法权利。我们不会因暴力、威胁或出于政治动机的骚扰而受到恐吓、噤声或被迫退出民主空间。”他呼吁对枪击、车辆被毁、DSS人员被拘留、Aliyu K.C.及其同伙涉嫌参与袭击、威胁酒店经营者以及拒绝提供场地等事件展开全面调查，并保护ADC候选人、领导人和支持者。他还敦促所有州属安全机构保持政治中立，不得被用于党派活动。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕消息和独家角度，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: U.S. President Donald Trump has said the United States would talk to North Korea if it is found to be behind the theft of more than $6 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Trump made the remarks at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Palm Beach, Florida, on Saturday after the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea was responsible for the theft of virtual assets from Binance on or about Oct. 29. "I'm not concerned. We're learning about it," he said. "We don't know if it's North Korea, but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it." In a cyber alert, the FBI identified the North Korean cyber operation as "TraderTraitor," a name previously associated with cryptocurrency thefts carried out by North Korean hackers. The agency said it had observed the hackers converting stolen assets primarily into Ethereum, a major cryptocurrency, in cooperation with the U.S. Secret Service and the Internal Revenue Service's Criminal Investigation division. The FBI warned that the hackers were expected to further launder the stolen assets through decentralized finance platforms and cryptocurrency exchange services that allow users to quickly swap one digital asset for another. The three U.S. agencies urged cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain operators, analytics firms and other virtual asset service providers to block transactions involving digital wallet addresses used by the North Korean hackers to launder the stolen funds. The FBI's announcement follows an assessment by U.S. blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs, which earlier attributed the estimated $6.36 billion Binance theft to TraderTraitor. Trump's remarks come amid persistent speculation over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. Trump and Kim met three times during Trump's first presidential term. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday that Trump remains open to talks with Kim if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, though no meeting has been scheduled

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump remains open to talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, but no meeting has been scheduled, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday. Rubio made the remarks during a press conference following a Group of 20 (G20) foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. "I think the president's perspective is, if North Korea and Kim Jong-un is prepared to talk with the United States about issues that are of concern to us and of concern to our allies, like South Korea, he would be open to doing it," Rubio said. "Nothing has been scheduled. I do not have anything to announce in regards to that today," he added. His remarks came amid persistent speculations over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and Kim, who held three meetings during Trump's first presidential term. The comments also followed trilateral talks among Rubio and his South Korean and Japanese counterparts in Atlanta on Friday, during which the three top diplomats reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea. "The president doesn't view talks, doesn't view meeting with someone as a concession." Rubio said. "I know in traditional foreign policy, meeting with someone or inviting someone to something is viewed as a concession that somehow legitimizes them." Asked of recent U.S. visa refusal or delay cases involving South Korean legislators, Rubio said the two countries will "work through" the issue on a bilateral basis. "I think there was one particular visa individual, that there was an issue about regarding behavior, perhaps a couple decades ago. But we'll work through that at a bilateral basis," the secretary said. Rep. Jin Sung-joon of South Korea's ruling Democratic Party (DP) said he has been issued a U.S. visa for a trip to the U.S. Pacific Command, days after he said his application was rejected. Jin's initial visa rejection followed a similar case involving Rep. Jung Chung-rae, former chairman of the DP, earlier this month
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 鲁比奥：特朗普愿与朝鲜领导人会谈，但尚未安排会晤
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥周六表示，如果朝鲜愿意讨论令华盛顿及其盟友关切的问题，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍愿与朝鲜领导人金正恩会谈，但目前尚未安排会面。鲁比奥是在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团外长会议结束后的新闻发布会上作出上述表态的。鲁比奥说：“我认为总统的态度是，如果朝鲜和金正恩准备就令我们以及韩国等盟友关切的问题与美国对话，他愿意进行会谈。目前没有任何安排。我今天在这方面没有什么可宣布的。”此前，外界一直猜测特朗普与金正恩可能重启外交接触。金正恩曾在特朗普首个总统任期内与他举行三次会面。这些表态此前还出现在鲁比奥与其韩国和日本 counterparts 周五于亚特兰大举行的三方会谈之后，三名最高外交官在会谈中重申了对朝鲜完全无核化的承诺。鲁比奥说：“总统不认为进行会谈或与某人见面是一种让步。我知道，在传统外交政策中，与某人见面或邀请某人参加某种活动，会被视为一种让步，仿佛这样就能赋予他们合法性。”当被问及美国近期拒绝或延迟向韩国议员发放签证的案件时，鲁比奥表示，两国将在双边基础上“妥善处理”这个问题。这名国务卿说：“我记得有一名特定的签证申请人，可能因行为方面的问题遭到拒签，那或许是几十年前的事了。但我们会在双边基础上妥善处理。”韩国执政党民主党议员 진成俊表示，他已获发赴美国太平洋司令部的美国签证；就在几天前，他曾称自己的签证申请遭到拒发。진成俊最初遭拒签之前，本月早些时候，该党前主席郑忠莱也遭遇了类似情况

Unlock these with Subscription The government on Saturday (October 31, 2026) slashed the export duty on petrol to nil while hiking the levy on export of diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹3 per litre and 50 paise per litre respectively for the next 15-day period. There was no change in the existing excise duty rates for petrol and diesel for domestic consumption. Diesel exports would now draw a levy of ₹11.5 for every litre against ₹8.5 per litre it drew in the previous fortnight. ATF would be subject to an export levy of ₹11 for every litre against ₹10.5 for every litre as mandated for the previous fortnight. The revised levy on diesel assumes significance as India spiked its exports of the liquid vehicular fuel amid a global supply crunch, particularly in Europe. According to data from real-time analytics provider Kpler, India’s diesel exports stood at 700 kilo barrels per day in October, the highest since September 2025. The government has been conducting a fortnightly review of export levies since March 27, in the backdrop of the conflict in West Asia. These are done based on the average international benchmark prices of crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF observed since the previous review. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met separately with his German and Polish counterparts on the sidelines of a Group of 20 (G20) meeting in Atlanta to discuss ways to enhance bilateral cooperation, his office said Saturday. Cho met with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on Friday (U.S. time), expressing hope for deeper ties with the European nation in a wide range of areas, including defense, the economy and cutting-edge industries, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In response, Wadephul thanked Seoul's foreign ministry for successfully preparing for German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's recent visit to Korea and expressed hope for expanded cooperation in bilateral trade and investment. Cho also met with his Polish counterpart, Radoslaw Sikorski, and called for continued discussions on cooperation in areas such as defense and batteries as a follow-up to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk's visit to Korea in April, the ministry said. Sikorski also requested Korea's attention and support for Warsaw's efforts to join the G20, with Cho proposing continued consultations on the matter

https://leadership.ng/fg-tasks-nigerians.body: The Executive Vice Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the National Agency for Science and Engineering Infrastructure (NASENI), Mr Khalil Suleiman Halilu, made the call during the distribution of solar home systems, clean cooking stoves and household support packs to 330 residents of Ondo State in Akure. Halilu said the initiative was designed to translate research and development into practical products that could improve living conditions and provide economic opportunities for Nigerians. He explained that the solar home systems would provide lighting for households, enable children to study at night and support small businesses, while the clean cooking stoves would offer more efficient cooking alternatives and reduce exposure to smoke when properly used. According to him, wider adoption of locally developed products would encourage domestic manufacturing and strengthen Nigeria’s capacity to develop solutions to its own challenges. He said “This is to promote locally produced items which brings about employment and also to have something good for our communities. He said the NASENI Sustainable Empowerment Programme had reached more than 10 states across the six geopolitical zones, with 330 men and women benefiting from the intervention in Ondo State. The NASENI chief executive added that the programme was intended to take technological innovations beyond research facilities and make them accessible to households and businesses. Also speaking, the Minister of Youth Development, Ayodele Olawande, said beneficiaries would receive additional financial support to enable them to establish or strengthen micro-businesses. Olawande said the intervention was not a political strategy but an effort to take technology-based solutions and economic opportunities to grassroots communities. In his remarks, gov. Yusuf commended Abejide for extending his empowerment programme beyond his constituency, urging other federal lawmakers to support Nigerians irrespective of their ethnic or religious backgrounds. https://leadership.ng/fg-tasks-nigerians.body_zh: 国家科学与工程基础设施局（NASENI）执行副主席兼首席执行官Khalil Suleiman Halilu先生，在阿库雷向奥 ND州330名居民分发太阳能家庭系统、清洁炊具和家居支持包时发出了这一号召。Halilu表示，该倡议旨在将研究与开发成果转化为实用产品，以改善生活条件，并为尼日利亚人提供经济机会。他解释说，太阳能家庭系统将为家庭提供照明，使儿童能够在夜间学习，并支持小型企业；正确使用时，清洁炊具可提供更高效的烹饪方式，并减少烟雾暴露。据他介绍，推广本地研发产品将鼓励国内制造，增强尼日利亚自主开发应对自身挑战解决方案的能力。他说：“这是为了推广本地生产的产品，既能带来就业，也能让我们的社区获得优质产品。”他说，NASENI可持续发展计划已覆盖全国六个地缘政治区域中的10多个州，其中330名男女在奥ND州受益于该项干预。NASENI首席执行官还表示，该计划旨在让技术创新走出研究机构，使家庭和企业都能获得这些成果。青年发展部长Ayodele Olawande也表示，受益者将获得额外财政支持，以便创办或强化微型企业。Olawande称，这项干预并非政治策略，而是旨在把基于技术的解决方案和经济机会带到基层社区。在发言中，州长Yusuf赞扬Abejide将其赋能计划延伸至选区之外，并敦促其他联邦议员不论尼日利亚人的族裔或宗教背景，都向其提供支持。他说，此类干预将促进国家团结、和平共处和经济发展。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp频道，获取全天候最新动态 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.summary: It is against this backdrop that the House of Representatives has begun consideration of a new bill seeking to regulate advance rent payments and protect tenants from what it describes as unlawful rental practices. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.summary_zh: 正是在这一背景下，美国众议院开始审议一项新法案，旨在规范预付租金并保护租户免受其所称非法租赁行为的侵害。违反拟议中的12个月上限而支付租金的租户，可向拟设立的首联邦首都地区租金监管与租户保护管理局申请退款。该法案规范可一次性要求支付的租金数额，但不规定房东实际可收取的租金金额。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.body: For many residents of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), securing a roof over their heads can mean raising hundreds of thousands, and sometimes millions, of naira at once. Beyond the annual rent itself, prospective tenants often have to contend with agency, agreement and caution fees, while existing tenants face rent increases that can force them to move to less expensive and sometimes more distant communities. It is against this backdrop that the House of Representatives has begun consideration of a new bill seeking to regulate advance rent payments and protect tenants from what it describes as unlawful rental practices. The Federal Capital Territory Advance Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Bill, 2026 (HB.2839), jointly sponsored by Paul Nnamchi (APC, Enugu) and Ahmed Doro (PDP, Katsina), passed first reading on Thursday, 22 October. But the proposal is not simply another attempt to tell landlords how much rent to collect. A closer look at the 17-page bill obtained by PREMIUM TIMES shows that it seeks to create an entire regulatory framework for tenancy in the FCT, covering advance payments, written agreements, agents, complaints, refunds, eviction practices, penalties and dispute resolution. The central provision is contained in Section 4 of the bill. Section 4(1) of the bill provides that a landlord, estate agent or property manager “shall not demand, receive or compel a tenant to pay more than twelve months’ rent in advance” as a condition for granting, renewing or continuing a tenancy. This simply prohibits the demanding, receiving or compelling of a tenant to pay more than one year’s rent in advance as a condition for obtaining, renewing or continuing a tenancy. That means the bill does not ban advance rent or make monthly rent compulsory. Instead, it establishes 12 months as the maximum amount that can be compulsorily demanded upfront. A landlord would still be able to collect one year’s rent in advance if that is the agreed arrangement. But demanding two or three years as a condition for granting or renewing a tenancy would become an offence if the bill becomes law. The bill also attempts to prevent landlords and agents from simply finding another way around the restriction. It specifically lists intermediaries, unexplained premiums, compulsory service charges, artificial renewal or re-grant of a tenancy, separate agreements and other arrangements designed to extract more than 12 months’ rent in advance as prohibited means of evasion. The proposed restriction has an exception. Section 4(4) states that a tenant may voluntarily pay more than 12 months’ rent in advance if “the tenant initiates the offer” and the payment is not imposed by the landlord and the tenant must not have been subjected to coercion, discrimination, threats or retaliation. The agreement must be recorded in writing, and the person receiving the payment bears the burden of proving compliance. This could become one of the contentious provisions during the legislative process. While the bill attempts to distinguish voluntary payments from compulsory demands, proving that a tenant genuinely volunteered to pay several years’ rent could be difficult where the landlord controls access to the property. The proposed law also seeks to formalise the relationship between landlords and tenants. Section 5 requires landlords or their authorised agents to provide written tenancy agreements stating the rent, payment schedule, duration of the tenancy, refundable deposits, fees and other charges, and the rights and obligations of both parties. Landlords and agents would also be required to disclose the nature, amount and legal basis of compulsory fees before a tenancy agreement is concluded and issue receipts or verifiable electronic acknowledgements for payments. The bill also prohibits retaliation against tenants who refuse to make unlawful payments or who complain about violations. A landlord or agent would not be allowed to threaten or unlawfully evict such a tenant, impose a punitive charge, withdraw a lawful benefit or otherwise retaliate against the tenant. The bill introduces a remedy that could significantly change the balance between tenants and landlords. Section 7 introduces a mechanism for recovering unlawfully collected rent. A tenant who has paid rent in violation of the proposed 12-month limit could apply to the proposed FCT Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Authority for a refund. Where the proposed authority determines that a payment contravened the law, it may order the recipient to refund the unlawful amount within 30 days. The bill also allows an aggrieved party to appeal an order of the authority to the FCT High Court. “7(1) A tenant who has paid rent in contravention of section 4 may apply to the Authority for a refund order. (2) Where the Authority determines that a payment was received in contravention of section 4, it may order the recipient to refund the unlawful amount within thirty days after service of the order.” Under Section 8, the bill proposes the establishment of the Federal Capital Territory Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Authority. The authority would receive and investigate complaints, monitor landlords, estate agents and property managers, issue compliance notices, facilitate mediation, order refunds and refer suspected criminal offences to relevant law-enforcement or prosecuting authorities. It would also establish complaint offices and electronic reporting channels throughout the FCT, including satellite towns, and publish periodic reports on rental practices and enforcement outcomes. Its governing board would include representatives of the FCT Administration, the federal ministry responsible for housing, the federal ministry responsible for justice, tenants, landlords or property owners and estate surveyors and valuers. The president will appoint the chairperson and members of the board, subject to Senate confirmation. The president will also appoint the director-general, subject to Senate confirmation. A person convicted of knowingly demanding or receiving unlawful advance rent would face a fine of between ₦500,000 and ₦5 million. A corporate body could face a fine of between ₦5 million and ₦20 million. The court could also order refunds, compensation for proven losses and payment of lawful costs. Failure to comply with a compliance notice issued by the proposed authority would also constitute an offence punishable by a fine of up to ₦1 million. Estate agents and property managers are expressly covered. Where an offence is committed through an intermediary, anyone who knowingly authorised, participated in or facilitated the offence could also be liable. The bill is not solely about the amount of money tenants pay. It also targets the methods some landlords may use to recover possession. It prohibits violence or threats, disconnecting essential services, removing or damaging a tenant’s property, changing locks without lawful authority and other forms of unlawful self-help. At the same time, it makes clear that tenants remain obliged to pay rent lawfully due and that landlords retain the right to recover rent and possession through due process. This is significant because the bill attempts to protect tenants without removing landlords’ existing property rights. This is perhaps the biggest question the lawmakers will have to confront. The bill regulates how much rent can be demanded upfront, but it does not regulate the actual amount landlords can charge as rent. There is no rent ceiling and no limit on how much rent can increase when a tenancy is renewed. A landlord who cannot demand two years’ rent upfront could still charge a high annual rent. The bill also does not address the shortage of affordable housing, construction costs, mortgage access or the wider factors driving rent increases. The proposed authority would have to monitor landlords and agents, investigate complaints and enforce its decisions across the FCT. The bill also provides for the authority to become operational within six months of the law taking effect. Despite its proposed restrictions on advance rent, the bill does not comprehensively regulate other charges tenants face when securing accommodation in Abuja, including agency fees, agreement fees and caution deposits. In Abuja, these charges are random and some tenants pay as high as 40 per cent of their rent for them. Although Section 5 requires landlords and agents to disclose the nature and amount of charges, it does not prescribe a maximum percentage or amount that can be demanded as agency or agreement fees. Neither does it establish a standard ceiling for caution deposits. The bill requires refundable deposits to be stated in tenancy agreements but does not clearly set out a standard formula for calculating them. This means tenants could have a clearer right to know what they are paying for without necessarily having protection against excessive charges. Section 4 prohibits landlords and agents from using charges that are not reasonably related to a service as a means of circumventing the 12-month advance rent restriction. However, this does not amount to a comprehensive regulation of legitimate agency fees or other letting costs. Consequently, tenants could still face substantial upfront expenses even if the bill becomes law. A landlord may no longer be able to compel a tenant to pay two years’ rent, but the tenant could still be required to pay agency, agreement and other charges, provided those charges comply with the law. Another major issue left unresolved is the payment arrangement for salary earners. Many Abuja residents earn monthly salaries but are expected to pay a full year’s rent upfront, with some landlords demanding two years’ rent from new tenants. For workers whose income comes in monthly, raising such a large sum at once can be difficult, even when they can afford the rent over the course of a year. The proposed law would prohibit landlords from compelling tenants to pay more than 12 months’ rent in advance. However, it does not require landlords to accept monthly or quarterly payments. A landlord could therefore still insist on a full year’s rent upfront, provided the demand does not exceed the proposed limit. This means the bill addresses the length of compulsory advance rent but does not fully address the financial difficulty created by the annual payment system. A tenant who cannot raise 12 months’ rent at once may therefore remain unable to secure accommodation, even if the landlord is no longer demanding two years’ payment. The latest proposal is part of a longer-running attempt by lawmakers to address rent practices in Abuja. In January 2022, the Senate introduced a bill sponsored by Smart Adeyemi, then representing Kogi West, seeking to regulate the payment of rent in the FCT. The bill passed second reading in February 2022. PREMIUM TIMES reported at the time that the proposal sought to reduce advance rent for new tenants from the prevailing one- or two-year payments to three months, followed by monthly payments. Mr Adeyemi argued that the existing system placed an excessive burden on low-income residents, particularly salaried workers who could not easily raise one or two years’ rent at once. While supporters argued that advance rent was placing unbearable pressure on residents, Chimaroke Nnamani, then the senator for Enugu East, opposed the proposal, arguing that rent payment was an economic matter that should be driven by market forces, including the availability of land, construction costs and income. He argued that the government should instead invest in housing schemes, mortgages and housing credit rather than regulate the business of private landlords. The Senate nevertheless voted overwhelmingly for the bill at second reading and referred it to the Committee on Housing and Urban Development for further consideration.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.title_zh: 关于阿布贾拟议房屋租金监管法案，你需要了解的一切
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.body_zh: 对联邦首都 Territory（FCT）的许多居民来说，拥有一个遮风挡雨的家可能意味着一次性筹集数十万，有时甚至是数百万奈拉。除了全年租金本身外，准租户往往还要应对中介费、签约费押金和押金，而现有租户则面临租金上涨，这可能迫使他们搬往价格较低、有时距离更远的社区。正是在这一背景下，众议院开始审议一项新法案，旨在规范预付租金并保护租户免受其所称非法租赁行为的侵害。《2026年联邦首都预付租金监管与租户保护法案》（HB.2839）由保罗·纳姆奇（APC，埃努古州）和艾哈迈德·多罗（PDP，卡齐纳州）共同提案，于10月22日星期四通过一读。但该提案并非只是又一attempt试图规定房东应收取多少租金。PREMIUM TIMES获得的这份17页法案显示，它试图为FCT的租赁关系建立一套完整的监管框架，涵盖预付款、书面协议、中介、投诉、退款、驱逐程序、处罚和争议解决。法案的核心规定载于第4条。法案第4条第1款规定，房东、房地产中介或物业管理人不得将“要求、收取或迫使租户预付超过12个月租金”作为授予、续租或延续租赁关系的条件。这实际上禁止将要求、收取或迫使租户预付超过一年租金作为取得、续租或延续租赁关系的条件。这意味着，该法案并不禁止预付租金，也不强制要求按月付租。相反，它将12个月确立为可被强制要求一次性预付的最高金额。如果双方约定预付一年租金，房东仍可据此收取。但若法案成为法律，将两年或三年租金作为授予或续租租赁关系的条件将成为违法行为。法案还试图防止房东和中介另辟蹊径规避这一限制。法案明确将中介费、来路不明的额外费用、强制服务费、人为安排续租或重新授予租赁关系、另订协议以及其他旨在收取超过12个月预付租金的安排列为禁止的规避手段。拟议限制设有一项例外。第4条第4款规定，如果“租户主动提出”，且该付款并非房东强加，租户也未受到胁迫、歧视、威胁或报复，租户可以自愿预付超过12个月的租金。相关协议必须以书面形式记录，并由收取款项的一方承担证明合规的责任。这可能成为立法过程中的一项争议条款。尽管法案试图区分自愿付款与强制要求，但在房东掌控物业使用权的的情况下，要证明租户确实自愿支付数年租金可能十分困难。拟议法律还试图将房东与租户之间的关系正规化。第5条要求房东或其授权中介提供书面租赁协议，注明租金、付款时间表、租赁期限、可退还押金、各项费用及其他收费，以及双方的权利和义务。房东和中介还必须在租赁协议订立前披露强制收费的性质、金额和法律依据，并为付款出具收据或可核验的电子确认凭证。法案还禁止房东或中介报复拒绝支付非法款项或投诉违法行为的租户。房东或中介不得威胁或非法驱逐此类租户、施加惩罚性收费、收回合法利益或以其他方式报复租户。法案引入的一项救济措施可能显著改变租户与房东之间的力量平衡。第7条引入了追讨非法收取租金的机制。违反拟议12个月上限而支付了租金的租户，可以向拟议的FCT租金监管与租户保护管理局申请退款。若该管理局认定某笔付款违反法律，可以命令收款方在30天内退还非法收取的金额。法案还允许受侵害一方向FCT高等法院上诉管理局的命令。规定如下：“第7条（1）违反第4条支付租金的租户，可以向管理局申请退款命令。（2）管理局认定某笔付款系违反第4条收取的，可以命令收款方在命令送达后30天内退还非法金额。”根据第8条，法案提议成立联邦首都租金监管与租户保护管理局。该管理局将受理并调查投诉，监督房东、房地产中介和物业管理人，发出合规通知，促成调解，责令退款，并将涉嫌犯罪的案件移交相关执法或检察机关。它还将在FCT各地，包括各卫星城设立投诉办公室和电子举报渠道，并定期发布有关租赁实践和执法结果的报告。其董事会将包括FCT行政机关、负责住房事务的联邦部委、负责司法事务的联邦部委、租户、房东或物业所有者以及土地测量师和估价师的代表。总统将任命董事会主席和成员，但须经参议院确认。总统还将任命总干事，同样须经参议院确认。明知要求或收取非法预付租金的人一旦被定罪，将面临₦500,000至₦5 million的罚款。法人团体可能面临₦5 million至₦20 million的罚款。法院还可责令退款、赔偿经证实的损失并支付合法费用。不遵守拟议管理局发出的合规通知，也将构成犯罪，可处以最高₦1 million的罚款。房地产中介和物业管理人被明确纳入适用范围。若通过中介实施犯罪，任何明知并授权、参与或协助实施犯罪的人也可能承担责任。这部法案的意义不只在于租户支付多少钱。它还针对部分房东可能用来收回物业占有权的手段。法案禁止暴力或威胁、切断基本生活服务、搬走或损坏租户财物、未经合法授权更换门锁以及其他形式的非法自助行为。与此同时，法案明确规定，租户仍有义务依法支付应付租金，房东也仍有权通过正当程序收回租金和物业占有权。这一点十分重要，因为该法案试图在不剥夺房东现有财产权利的情况下保护租户。这或许是议员们必须面对的最大问题。法案对可预付租金的数额作出监管，但并未规定房东实际可收取的租金金额。法案没有设定租金上限，也没有限制续租时租金可以上涨多少。无法要求预付两年租金的房东，仍可收取较高的年租金。法案也未处理可负担住房短缺、建筑成本、按揭贷款可获得性以及推高租金的其他更广泛因素。拟议管理局将不得不监督房东和中介、调查投诉并在FCT各地执行决定。法案还规定，该管理局须在法律生效后六个月内开始运作。尽管该法案对预付租金提出限制，但它没有全面监管租户在阿布贾获取住房时面临的其他收费，包括中介费、签约费押金和押金。在阿布贾，这些收费随意收取，有些租户为此支付的金额高达租金的40%。尽管第5条要求房东和中介披露收费的性质和金额，但并未规定中介费或签约费可收取的最高百分比或金额，也没有为押金设定统一上限。法案要求在租赁协议中注明可退还押金，但未明确列出计算押金的标准公式。这意味着，租户或许能更清楚地了解自己支付的是什么，却未必能获得防止过高收费的保护。第4条禁止房东和中介利用与服务没有合理关联的费用，作为规避12个月预付租金限制的手段。但这并不等于对合法中介费或其他出租成本进行全面监管。因此，即使该法案成为法律，租户仍可能面临巨额前期费用。房东或许不能再强迫租户支付两年租金，但只要相关收费符合法律，租户仍可能被要求支付中介费、签约费和其他费用。另一个尚未解决的重要问题是工薪阶层租户的付款安排。许多阿布贾居民按月领取工资，却仍被要求一次性预付全年租金，一些房东还会向新租户索要两年租金。对按月取得收入的劳动者来说，即使其能够在一年过程中负担得起租金，一次筹集如此巨额资金仍很困难。拟议法律将禁止房东迫使租户预付超过12个月的租金，但并不要求房东接受按月或按季付款。因此，只要所要求的金额不超过拟议上限，房东仍可坚持要求一次性预付全年租金。这意味着，该法案处理了强制预付租金的期限问题，却未完全解决年度付款制度造成的经济困难。因此，无法一次筹集12个月租金的租户，可能仍无法获得住房，即便房东已不再索要两年预付款。这项最新提案是议员们为处理阿布贾租赁收费问题而进行的长期努力的一部分。2022年1月，参议院提出一项由时任代表科吉西部选区的斯马特·阿德耶米提案的法案，试图规范FCT的租金支付。该法案于2022年2月通过二读。PREMIUM TIMES当时报道称，该提案寻求将新租户预付租金从当时普遍存在的一年或两年改为三个月预付，此后按月支付。阿德耶米先生认为，现有制度给低收入居民，特别是难以一次筹集一年或两年租金的工薪阶层造成了过重负担。支持者认为预付租金给居民带来难以承受的压力，但时任恩努古东部选区参议员奇马罗克·纳马尼反对该提案，主张租金支付属于经济问题，应由土地供应、建筑成本和收入等市场力量决定。他认为，政府应转而投资住房计划、按揭贷款和住房信贷，而不是监管私人房东的经营。尽管如此，参议院仍在二读时以压倒性多数投票通过该法案，并将其提交住房与城市发展委员会进一步审议。
